meta_description:
83K likes, 590 comments - prattprattpratt on October 28, 2026: "Happy 50th birthday to my big brother. My hero. Cully Pratt.

When I was a kid I wanted to be just like Cully. I used to wear his clothes the day after he did, picked em right up off his floor and put them on because they smelled so good and he knew how to match. Haha. I looked up to him that much. He played Boo Bear in the Christmas Play and that made me want to be an actor. Truth is, I don’t think there’s a single part of the man I am today that wasn’t shaped in some way by him.

He’s an incredible artist. A craftsman. A father. He served his country in the Army and his community in law enforcement. But those are just things he’s done. Who he is, is a good man. A really good man.

Life gets busy. We don’t spend nearly as much time together as we used to. I miss that. I miss being kids. I miss looking up to him every day. Funny thing is, I still do.
I love you, brother. More than I probably tell you. You were my first hero. Fifty years on this earth and I’m so grateful I got to spend mine being your little brother.

Happy Birthday Bro!".
